text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp had arrived once 
again. Gold City seemed to be in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to get even stronger and defeat 
formidable rivals at the Japan Cup, the 
curtain rises on an intense summer 
training camp!
